description: Generates normalized 3,072-dimensional or 768-dimensional semantic vector embeddings via Google Gemini Embedding 2 for RAG indexing and cosine-similarity search. Use when embedding text passages or queries via L402 Lightning with configurable Matryoshka dimensions; for running live Google Search grounded factual queries, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-embedding-2'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

model.description: Gemini embedding model version; defaults to 'gemini-embedding-2' when omitted.

text.description: Input text passage, code snippet, or search query to embed into a float vector.

name: generate_gemini_embeddings
title: Gemini Embedding 2 High-Dimensional (3,072-D) Vector Generator
